Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u084/system/state/workspace/programs/task-54966ffb.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify the full-width separator row (color 2), background, and movable object.
    sep = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] == 2)
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    obj_colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (bg, 2)}
    obj = next(iter(obj_colors))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == obj]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, c in cells:
        out[r][c] = bg
    min_r = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    max_r = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    min_c = min(c for _, c in cells)
    max_c = max(c for _, c in cells)
    if max_r < sep:
        new_min = sep - 1 - (max_r - min_r)
        delta = new_min - min_r
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r + delta][c] = obj
        stripe = new_min - 1
    else:
        new_min = sep + 1
        delta = new_min - min_r
        for r, c in cells:
            out[r + delta][c] = obj
        stripe = new_min + (max_r - min_r) + 1
    if 0 <= stripe < h:
        out[stripe] = [8] * w
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    test = [[1]*27 for _ in range(9)]
    test[1][16:21] = [3]*5
    test[4] = [2]*27
    result = transform(test)
    for row in result:
        print(' '.join(map(str, row)))
    assert result[2] == [8]*27
    assert result[3][16:21] == [3]*5
    assert result[4] == [2]*27
    assert all(v == 1 for r, row in enumerate(result) for c, v in enumerate(row) if r not in (2,3,4))
    demo = [[0]*16 for _ in range(29)]
    demo[9] = [2]*16
    demo[23][9:15] = [1]*6
    demo[24][9:15] = [1]*6
    demo[25][9:11] = [1]*2
    demo[25][13:15] = [1]*2
    d = transform(demo)
    assert d[13] == [8]*16 and d[9] == [2]*16
    assert d[10][9:15] == [1]*6 and d[11][9:15] == [1]*6 and d[12][9:15] == [1,1,0,0,1,1]
    print('demo verification passed')
